reviews.text:
My old pet sitter recommended this vet so I gave it a go. Big mistake. Took my cat in for a checkup because he hadn’t been eating well. The vet did an X-ray and it showed he hadn’t emptied so they suggested an enema. These can be very dangerous for your cat but I thought they knew what they were doing. They did not. When they brought him back into the room he was groaning and when I asked why he was making that sound she said he’s fine.
Fast forward 2 hours and we’re at the emergency vet. He’s fading, temp has dropped 7 degrees and his heart is dehydrated. My cat never recovered and after two cardiac arrests, I had to put him down. I spoke with the er dr and told him the vet had given him an enema. He said that wasn’t a big deal as 10-30 ml was common practice. When I told them they gave him 90 ml!!!!! (Wth?!) the look on his face said it all.
When we were leaving family pet, I ran into one of the vet techs who had assisted in the enema and she said, “good luck.” Yeah well there was no luck to be had thanks to you and your clinic. You all killed my cat.

I cannot express in words how thankful and grateful I am to the entire staff, especially Dr. Gutierrez, Dr. Cheung, and Erica for taking such good care of my boy and saving his life yesterday. Nibbler is recovering well at Hoffman Estates specialty thanks to them, and I will forever be so grateful.
Dr Driscoll is amazing. The support staff is kind and professional and the office is immaculate. They all care so much about our pets!
Love family pet!

Unsure how I've gone this long without making my feelings Google Review Official, but do you remember the episode of Friends where Monica spends an hour on her balcony yelling "I'm engaged!!" repeatedly after she gets engaged? That's basically the same level of enthusiasm I have when anyone asks for a veterinarian recommendation and that's how I end up peer pressuring them into becoming new Family Pet clients.

In all seriousness, the Family Pet team has been there for my cat, Sinatra, and me at both our best and worst moments, and we could not be more grateful for their above-and-beyond care and hospitality. I'm not exaggerating when I say I would die for every single person on their staff. And you know what? I trust them with my own medical needs more than I do my current primary rando with the letters MD after his name. If I'm having chest pains, I'm not calling 911 I'm calling Dr. Kelly Gutierrez! If I'm spiraling because my male cat is doing problematic male cat things, Dr. Lindsey Driscoll's voice is instantly lowering my blood pressure! If I'm catsitting and my little client develops bloody diarrhea, it's Dr. Cailyn Challinor to the rescue! If I'm having an existential crisis, Dr. Cynthia Gonzalez is there to save the entire day in addition to my sanity! We haven't met Dr. Justin Cheung yet but given that Sinatra's patient file is likely thicker than the average vet med textbook, we probably will at some point, and we cannot wait. Sinatra loves all of his doctors here so much that he even developed a crush on one of them and faked chronic constipation so we'd have to go to Family Pet nearly every week for butt stuff (we have since had a chat and I am happy to report that he is no longer in his stalking people in their workplace era).

Oh you think this review is unhinged? Imagine the voicemails I leave them. And somehow they don't entirely hate talking to me?! It's almost like the gates to heaven sit at 1401 W Webster and the angels all happen to work at Family Pet in their spare time. Now I'm not one to throw the "do you know who I am?!?!?!" flex in anyone's face, but if you go to Family Pet and tell them Sinatra sent you, those words will carry weight, believe me. BUT YOU CAN ONLY SAY THAT IF YOU'RE EXTRA NICE TO THEM ALL THE TIME because I swear to god do not make me fight you because you took advantage of our Family Pet Famous status.

In trazodone and Trader Joes,
Sarah & Sinatra

Dr Gonzales takes great care of my pets. She explains things in a way that is easy to understand.The majority of the staff has been working there for many years. They provide excellent customer service.
First time here! We loved it. They handled Bunny my dog with such care. Got all her vaccines taken care of so quickly. Definitely the place to go, will be our new vet moving forward.
Gertie has been going to Family Pet since she was a puppy. Her care is top notch. The whole team is invested in providing not only excellent care to the pups, but supporting their humans.

Family Pet Animal Hospital is absolutely wonderful! Dr. Cynthia is amazing. She is incredibly thorough, takes the time to answer all of your questions, and genuinely cares about both her patients and their families. You can tell she truly loves what she does.

Leonidas had a great visit and was treated with so much kindness and compassion from the moment we arrived. The entire team is friendly, welcoming, and makes you and your fur babies feel like part of the family. Their professionalism, warmth, and dedication to exceptional patient care truly stand out.

I highly recommend Family Pet Animal Hospital to anyone looking for a veterinary team that treats your pets as if they were their own. Thank you, Dr. Cynthia and team, for always taking such great care of Leonidas! 🐾❤️
We are honored to receive your 5-star rating. Your support means a great deal to our team.
Thank you for the 5 star review Richard! Please let us know if any one member or aspect of our team really stood out as we love to celebrate all of our victories!
We are always extremely happy with the care our dog gets!  All of the vets and staff are wonderful!
Always a great experience! Dr. Driscoll and the team are always so friendly and caring, and know how to make Alfie as comfortable as possible during his visits.
Great service,kind, and empathetic staff always caring and looking for the best intrest of my fur babies never had any issues
Loved my experience. The staff is always great with my puppy and me. Dr Cheung is the best!
Great service for my dogs checkup.
Thank you for the 5-stars!
Vets are caring and concerned. Folllow.up is great. Relying on Family Pet for over 10 years

Incredible experience. As new pet owners we had lots of questions (some dumb, some random) and were greeted with patience and enthusiasm. Would recommend Dr. Challinor to any and all of my friends and family.

I've been with FP for 25+ years and have had excellent guidance and care for every one of my many pets over these many years. I currently see Dr. Gonzalez and she has continued the FP tradition in provided outstanding care - and I  feel fortunate that she is my primary vet.

Great place. There was a lot of turnover when Thrive took over this formerly locally owned practice a few years ago but that seems to have settled down. We've been seeing Dr Gonzalez for the last 3 or 4 years and she's really great. She's very knowledgeable and you can tell how much she cares about your pet. Prices are typical for the area.
We are grateful to receive your 5-star rating. Your trust in Family Pet Animal Hospital means a great deal to us.
Hi Kate - thank you for the 5 star review! We really appreciate it - if anyone or any part of our service really stands, please let us know!

Family Pet, and especially Dr. Gutierrez, have provided wonderful  expert and compassionate care to my pets (2 cats, 1 dog) for 20 years. I had initially been nervous about continuing care there during the COVID years, when FPAH and so many other veterinary practices experienced vet staff turnover.  But I'm so happy I stayed with them. I can't thank Dr. Gutierrez enough for saving my sweet dog's life by finding her thyroid tumor in time to get it treated.  Dr. Gutierrez is really smart & experienced -- all of the things she found in her manual exams of my dog were confirmed exactly in lab tests & CT scans.  Also, all of the FPAH vets, techs, and front desk staff email and call to check up on their patients, even on weekends, and they always explain things with patience and compassion.

This is a fantastic practice, which I would recommend highly to anyone.

Overall experience was OK, but never found out if our cat's teeth were part of the examination, and apparently her blood pressure was not taken.  Paying over $500, wouldn' tthat be part of the exam????

The team at family pet and in particular Michele went all out and to great lengths to get us insulin for our diabetic dog and at the last minute and in a real pinch. They all could not have been more responsive and receptive and really saved us.  We couldn’t be in better hands! Thank you all very much!
Family Pet Animal Hospital is the BEST!  Piper is treated with special care every time!  We appreciate the entire staff!

Dr Justin Cheung was great in addressing my new puppy's needs. He was informative and thorough and also entertained my 4 year old son. The supportive staff especially Casandra, Sandy and Michelle were great!
Love Family Pet.  Dr Alvarez is fantastic!  I hate to see her go.  She will be missed!

The staff at Family Pet is phenomenal they have taken care of my pets for over 15 years and are always caring and concerned for what is best for my pet. Luke just received his first rabies vaccine and did wonderful and the staff absolutely loves him!

We highly recommend Family Pet Animal Hospital. Dr. Gutierrez is always very thorough with both our cats and dogs. The front desk staff is also excellent and consistently makes an effort to accommodate our needs whenever possible. We are happy to be long-term clients!

I've been taking my dogs here ever since I moved to this area (more than 20 years ago). They're very caring & take a personal interest in my pets.  They take the time to listen to and respond to my concerns.
Thank you for the 5 star review Stephany!
The entire staff truly cares about my dog  Loki! Dr. Alvarez is the best! She always goes out of her way to be sure Loki is getting the best care possible.

Family Pet was the primary vet for Buddy Dog's entire life. A few more bucks than going out to the burbs but the level of personal care when it matters, was fantastic. Everyone can be annoyed by the vet when your dog is healthy (it's like washing a clean car), HOWEVER, when Buddy became sick we were treated with priority, professionalism, and compassion. A+
Thank you Dr. Gonzalez and Sandy for taking such good care of my cat during his annual exam
expensive but I trust them!!!!!!

We switched over to Family Pet Animal hospital because of a recommendation from a dog owner we trust.  We are extremely happy with the service for our senior dog who is almost 17 years old.  Dr. Gutierrez has gone above and beyond all our expectations.  She is very knowledgeable, attentive, and detailed oriented.  We had a fire drill emergency with his inability to move his back leg, and she immediately laid out a path for us to follow.  We were relieved with the attention, the plan, and prioritizing us for an immediate visit to take care of our dog.  It meant so much to us, thank you Dr. Gutierrez!
Caring Doctors and staff!!  Bringing my dogs here for years.

The doctors and the techs did an excellent job today taking care of my recalcitrant cat Watson.  He can be a VERY uncooperative patient (having previously earned the nickname “Swatson” ☺️), but because of their patience, kindness, and skill, he was an almost-perfect gentleman for his exam, lab work, and vaccination.
I know all my pets (2 dogs in addition to Watson) get the very best care at Family Pet — no place else even comes close.
A special shout out to the “old-timers” there — Michelle, Tony, Janet, Sandy, Jim, Raymond, Casandra, and Ryn.  💕

Sadly, I am becoming more and more disappointed with this "company". Personally I love my vet Dr. Gonzalez. But trying to reach them is impossible. They NEVER pick up their phones, even when you press "1" for emergency. I have been going to Family Pet for at least 35 years. I think with Thrive acquiring them, this has turned them into a big company instead of the neighborhood vet. Even the inside is cold and unwelcoming. The prices were high, but they are insane now. Unless you pay for a "Thrive" membership. I am so disappointed. I think it's time for a new clinic.

I have been a client at Family Pet for many years and wouldn’t take any of my pets anywhere else for their primary care/urgent care needs. The doctors are compassionate and genuinely listen to my concerns and answer my questions (shout out specifically to Dr. Gonzalez), and the staff are equally as exceptional (Jim is legitimately a customer service superstar, Casandra is always quick to respond to all of my inquiries and is always courteous and thorough, and Tony is always up for handling my rambunctious dog for all of his frequent tech appointments for Cytopoint injections)!

Thank you, Family Pet, for making my pets feel like their part of your family!

We have been going to family pet for years - since we got our rescue with he was 1.5 years old (he’s now 12) and more recently with our puppy. The doctors, techs and staff are all great and very easy to work with. They follow up to check and see how our dogs are doing after appointments and give good advice. Lots of availability for appointments if you need something last minute.
I brought my cat in last weekend for a follow up visit and am very happy with the service provided by Dr. Gonzalez and Michelle.
Thank you for the 5 star review Laura - please let us know if any particular member of the team or quality of the service stood out to you.
Thank you for the 5 star review Therese. Please let us know if any particular team members really stood out for you!
Raymond was a pleasure to work with. He handled a question and issue we had regarding billing quickly and professionally.

Family pet is an absolutely wonderful veterinary practice! We have been bringing our cats here for the last 5 years and we are very very happy with the care they receive there.   Everyone on staff is very kind, very attentive, and genuinely cares about our cats. Some of our cats have needed surgery and we received excellent referrals and got that all taken care of. I have referred friends to Family Pet as well.  I absolutely would not take my pets anywhere else!
My girl came in as a new patient and can get very anxious at the vet. The staff was fantastic with her and our vet did a great job at examining her while making sure she was comfortable.

Dr.Guterrez was very kind and patient. Piper received an extremely thorough examination! Dr. Guterrez used a medical model to explain an orthopedic concern.i hope that she will be Piper’s veterinarian for many years. Technician Erica was gentle and firm and Angelica at the front desk was very helpful.
